generation_history.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Captain Livé modular FACE facial-hair piece, four-view modelling sheet for 3D reconstruction.
Input1 is the approved complete Captain, the design authority for his facial hair. Input2 is his new open-mouth clean-shaven head, used ONLY to fit facial hair positions and scale. Do NOT render any head or skin.
Create ONLY the facial-hair assembly: ONE small continuous dark espresso-brown moustache with two slim outward-swept pointed wings JOINED AT THE CENTRE under the nose, and ONE tiny pointed dark chin tuft/goatee located below it at the tip of his long chin. These two disconnected islands are the single requested face slot. Preserve their relative anatomical positions from the Captain reference. His moustache is restrained and slim, not an enormous handlebar, bushy beard, ringlet curls or broad smile. Each wing sweeps outward and slightly back toward the cheek from the attached central philtrum; it is ONE layer, no extra forward-floating set of whiskers. The moustache attaches snugly above the open upper lip. The tiny chin tuft does NOT connect to the moustache: clean white background between them. No skin bridge, mouth, teeth, tongue, nose, ears, cheeks, head, neck, sideburns, scalp hair, eyebrows, hat or stand.
One coherent turnaround of the EXACT SAME assembled facial-hair component: FRONT, LEFT profile (the component's front points left), BACK showing the attachment-facing reverse surfaces of those SAME moustache and chin tuft, RIGHT profile (front points right). Orthographic and level, same scale and orientation around a vertical axis. Both profile projections remain narrow; do not enlarge their depth to fill a frame. Rear view has the reverse of the moustache and little goatee, not an extra front view.
Layout: wide landscape high-resolution sheet, FOUR EQUAL-WIDTH INVISIBLE CELLS. Each cell contains precisely one moustache plus its small lower chin tuft together at the same spacing; keep all disconnected islands within their own cell. Whole object visible, same top height and bottom baseline across four. Large clear vertical white bands between cells. Pure flat white RGB255 background, no texture, shadows on background, labels, callouts, text, borders or diagrams.
Style: same clean dimensional stylized cartoon rendering and warm dark brown hair as approved Captain, simple visible clumps and restrained shading, no realistic individual hair filaments. Fitted to the approved Captain's narrow face (assembled character1.90m); moustache roughly0.13m wide, face assembly roughly0.10m from top of moustache to bottom of little chin tuft. Those are proportions, do not print measurements. Mouth must remain completely unobstructed when this assembly is fitted.
